help.subtitle: Complete user guide — from sign-in to business modules
help.footer: ERP Mobile · Razvan IVAN · ERPMobile@dateconta.ro · v%@
help.section_intro_p1: ERP Mobile is the Dateconta mobile app for company operations: master data, suppliers, clients, inventory, CRM, and Z reports (Zetta module).
help.section_intro_p2: Data is stored in the cloud (Supabase) and filtered by the active company. Each user only sees modules allowed by the administrator.
help.section_intro_b1: Sign in with email and password — account is created by an administrator.
help.section_intro_b2: Select the active company before working (bottom bar or Dashboard menu).
help.section_intro_b3: Modules appear on Home — access depends on role and permissions.
help.section_intro_b4: The Help tab (this manual) and the Utilities tab are always available from the navigation bar.
help.section_intro_tip: On first launch, change the default password if you are an administrator and verify the active company.
help.section_login_p1: At login enter the email and password from your administrator. The session stays active until logout.
help.section_login_p2: Superadmin can manage companies and users. Company admin manages their own users.
help.section_login_b1: Default password — change it immediately in Settings or at the first warning.
help.section_login_b2: Blocked user — contact the company administrator.
help.section_login_b3: No modules on Dashboard — administrator must grant module access.
help.section_login_b4: Logout — user menu in the Dashboard corner (person icon).
help.section_login_tip: Developer contact: ERPMobile@dateconta.ro — mention the app version from the bottom bar.
help.section_dashboard_p1: Home shows modules available for the active company: Suppliers, Clients, Inventory, HR, Master data, etc.
help.section_dashboard_p2: On iPad/Mac — large tiles; on iPhone — list. Tap a module to open it.
help.section_dashboard_b1: Suppliers — GRN, supplier invoices, payments, e-Invoice.
help.section_dashboard_b2: Clients — client situation, invoices, collections, and Zetta (Z reports).
help.section_dashboard_b4: Master data — items, partners, warehouses, company settings.
help.section_dashboard_b5: CRM — deals Kanban, leads, contacts, companies, quotes, activities, analytics, support tickets.
help.section_dashboard_b6: Company menu (top left) — switch active company if you have access to several.
help.section_dashboard_b7: Cash register — daily PDF journals from Z reports and manual receipts (HQ / work locations).
help.section_dashboard_b8: HR — human resources for the active company. Company administrators see the tile automatically; other users from the Users tab.
help.section_dashboard_tip: If you do not see a module, contact the administrator — permissions are managed in the Users tab.
help.section_company_p1: All operations run in the context of the selected company. The bottom bar shows company, user, and app version.
help.section_company_p2: Tap the company name in the bottom bar for quick settings of the current company.
help.section_company_b1: Switch company — building menu on Dashboard or selector in Settings.
help.section_company_b2: Active company Tax ID filters Zetta imports — Z reports from other companies are rejected.
help.section_company_b3: Version in bottom bar — tap for About app (from the Help tab).
help.section_company_b4: No company selected — some modules show a warning.
help.section_company_tip: Check Tax ID in Master data → Company settings if Zetta rejects valid receipts.
help.section_settings_p1: The Settings tab contains your account, app language, and company selector.
help.section_settings_p2: On Mac Catalyst you can create a Desktop shortcut for quick launch.
help.section_settings_b2: Language — Romanian, English, and other supported languages.
help.section_settings_b3: Current company — list of companies you can access.
help.section_settings_b6: Zetta settings — register shifts, work locations, cash/CARD/MODERN PAYMENT accounts, VAT rates A–D for the accounting note from Z reports.
help.section_settings_b7: Users — account and permission management (administrators only).
help.section_settings_tip: Changing language reloads the UI immediately — the manual is shown in the selected language (RO/EN).
help.section_users_p1: Users are opened from Settings → Users (visible to administrators only). Create accounts, block users, and set module permissions here.
help.section_users_b1: Add user — email, initial password, role.
help.section_users_b2: Module permissions — check modules visible on Dashboard.
help.section_users_b3: Block — user can no longer sign in.
help.section_users_b4: Superadmin and company admin — cannot be deleted from the app.
help.section_users_tip: Grant Clients access if the user works with Zetta or client situation. For HR, enable the HR module.
help.section_bulk_delete_p1: Several lists let you delete multiple records at once: supplier invoices, client invoices, GRNs, and Z reports. The delete button (red trash) is not shown on each row by default — you must first enter selection mode.
help.section_bulk_delete_p2: Many users look for a trash icon on every row first. Bulk delete works differently: it starts from the top bar with Select to delete (checklist icon), not a trash can.
help.section_bulk_delete_p3: This is available only if you have delete permission on that module. If you do not see the button, contact your administrator.
help.section_bulk_delete_b1: Step 1 — Open the list you need (e.g. Suppliers → Invoices, Suppliers → GRN, Clients → Client situation → Invoices, or Z reports).
help.section_bulk_delete_b2: Step 2 — Look at the top-right corner (navigation bar, next to the page title). Tap Select to delete (checklist icon). This is NOT the trash icon — it enables selection mode.
help.section_bulk_delete_b3: Step 3 — A checkbox appears next to each row. Tap rows to select them, or use Select all (top-right) — only visible rows are included (respects the active period filter).
help.section_bulk_delete_b4: Step 4 — After selecting at least one row, Delete selected (N) with a trash icon appears: top-right in the navigation bar AND on the bottom bar (above the safe area).
help.section_bulk_delete_b5: Step 5 — Tap Delete selected and confirm in the dialog. To cancel without deleting, tap Cancel (top-left) to exit selection mode.
help.section_bulk_delete_b6: Single-row delete: swipe the row left and tap Delete — works only when you are NOT in selection mode.
help.section_bulk_delete_b7: Supplier invoices — if an invoice has a linked GRN, the GRN is deleted automatically and received stock is updated.
help.section_bulk_delete_b8: Z reports — deleting also removes linked collections (cash, bank, modern payment) created on save.
help.section_bulk_delete_b9: On iPad and Mac (Catalyst) buttons are in the top-right toolbar; on iPhone, in the top navigation bar.
help.section_bulk_delete_b10: Without delete permission: Select to delete is hidden.
help.section_bulk_delete_tip: Remember: the red trash icon appears only after you select at least one row. If you cannot find delete, look for Select to delete at the top-right first.
help.section_nomenclatoare_p1: Master data (admin access) centralizes base data: items, partners, warehouses, recipes, company settings.
help.section_nomenclatoare_p2: Most operational modules read items and partners from master data.
help.section_nomenclatoare_b1: Items / products — sales/consumption UoM: pcs, Kg or litre; invoice purchase UoM (crate, box, case…) and factor (e.g. 1 crate = 24 pcs).
help.section_nomenclatoare_b4: Company settings — company data, Tax ID, logo.
help.section_nomenclatoare_b5: Recipes — raw materials ↔ finished goods links.
help.section_nomenclatoare_tip: Enter the company Tax ID correctly — Zetta uses it for receipt validation.
help.section_suppliers_p1: Suppliers covers procurement: GRN, supplier invoices, payments, and e-Invoice import.
help.section_suppliers_p2: The GRN is prepared in the sales/consumption UoM (pcs, Kg or litre). If the invoice is 1 pc (sack, bucket) and the name says 10KG or 5KG, receipt is converted to kg. You can correct the GRN quantity; purchase unit price recalculates, the line value stays. Stock updates on save.
help.section_suppliers_b1: GRN — an invoice can have several GRNs, one per warehouse. On a new GRN, the default quantity is the unreceived remainder. From the invoice list: “Invoice closed” when everything is received (or you closed the remainder); otherwise Add reception / Close. Cancelling a GRN without saving does not change stock. Changing the warehouse and saving moves stock to the new warehouse. Conversion only for Merchandise and Raw materials.
help.section_suppliers_b2: Supplier invoices — the list defaults to invoices created or imported today. Today / last 5 days / this month use the created or imported date. The date range uses the invoice date. The list loads only the selected filter, not every invoice in the database. Invoice date, GRN date and due date stay the day you enter.
help.section_suppliers_b4: e-Invoice import — ANAF XML into supplier invoices. Items with the same code, barcode, or name (LOT ignored) are reused. Potatoes/tomatoes/kapia use canonical sheets. If the name is only similar, the GRN shows a warning: keep the linked item or create a new one (like quantities inferred from the name).
help.section_suppliers_b5: PDF export — reports and GRN accounting documents.
help.section_suppliers_b6: Bulk delete — invoices and GRNs; see section 7 for steps (Select to delete at top-right).
help.section_suppliers_b7: Account sheet — actions (payment, edit, print, PDF, Excel, send, back) are icons on the white bar at the right.
help.section_suppliers_b8: Account sheet — Invoice balance is that invoice’s remainder (plus = still payable, minus = leftover credit note). Final balance is the running supplier total after the document, not the opposite sign of the invoice balance. An allocated credit note reduces payable invoice remainders and cannot be reallocated.
help.section_suppliers_tip: Scan barcodes on Mac/iPad with the built-in scanner on GRN lines.
help.section_clients_p1: Clients has two areas: Client situation (invoices, due dates, collections) and Zetta (Z reports → NextUp Excel).
help.section_clients_p2: Choose the desired tile after entering the Clients module.
help.section_clients_b1: Client situation — balances, issued invoices, collections, allocations. Invoice date and due date stay the day you enter.
help.section_clients_b2: Zetta — import Z receipts, generate accounting Excel.
help.section_clients_b3: Collections — automatic allocation to invoices by due date.
help.section_clients_b4: Zetta checks ERP company Tax ID — receipts from other companies are rejected.
help.section_clients_b5: Z reports — single delete (swipe) or bulk delete; see section 7 for selection mode and where the delete button appears.
help.section_clients_b6: Account sheet — actions (collection, ticket, edit, print, PDF, Excel, send, back) are icons on the white bar at the right.
help.section_clients_b7: Client collection with method Cash: after you save it there is no “Send to cash register” button. On Dashboard → Cash register → Generate registers, the collection appears automatically on the HQ register (“Collection invoice …”). Card, bank transfer, or another method does not go into cash.
help.section_clients_tip: The full Zetta manual is included below in the dedicated section — also available from Zetta (Help button).
help.section_inventory_p1: Inventory shows balances for the selected warehouse, movements, and stock take. A transfer note moves raw materials, merchandise, packaging, and consumables between warehouses on the note date.
help.section_inventory_p2: A stock take shows the book quantity of that warehouse when you open it. On save, book stock becomes the counted quantity, and differences are kept in a report.
help.section_inventory_b1: Balances — pick a warehouse to see that warehouse’s stock.
help.section_inventory_b2: Transfer note — from the stock list, the arrows icon. When editing you can delete lines (on Mac: trash); if no lines remain and you save, the note is deleted and stock is restored. On edit, stocks at both warehouses update. PDF dispatch note like the GRN.
help.section_inventory_b3: Stock take — pick the warehouse, count, save. Stock updates at the save date and time.
help.section_inventory_b4: Difference reports — the list next to stock takes, only when there are differences.
help.section_inventory_tip: If balance is wrong, check partial GRNs (remainder on another warehouse) or incomplete lines.
help.section_stock_sheet_p1: The Stock sheet tile on the Dashboard opens a full-width hub in the ERP modules area, with two tiles: Update opening stock and Generate stock sheet.
help.section_stock_sheet_p2: Flag items from Inventory → warehouse card or from Articles (“Used in stock sheet”). Generate lists the items and opens the accounting card; the list and card can be printed / exported as PDF or Excel.
help.section_stock_sheet_b1: Update opening stock — opening quantity and unit price; current stock is adjusted by the difference from the saved opening value.
help.section_stock_sheet_b2: Generate stock sheet — list with name, UoM, quantity, value; tap opens the In / Out / Stock card.
help.section_stock_sheet_b3: Icons on the right bar (generate/card): print, PDF, Excel, send.
help.section_stock_sheet_b4: Search by name, code, or barcode (including scanner).
help.section_stock_sheet_tip: If the list is empty, turn on “Used in stock sheet” on the items you keep in stock records.
help.section_hr_p1: The HR tile on the Dashboard opens the personnel hub for the active company: employees, contracts, payroll, timesheet, listings and schedule settings.
help.section_hr_p2: The flow is: set the company schedule → active contracts → Generate payroll → edit leave, sick leave and bonuses per person → Generate timesheet. The timesheet is not rebuilt on every keystroke. This is not a certified legal payroll engine (no Revisal / D112); you remain responsible for the final amounts.
help.section_hr_b1: Access: Dashboard → HR. Permissions in Users (view / create / edit / delete).
help.section_hr_b2: HR settings: Monday–Sunday schedule (works or not, start / end) and journal accounts 641 / 421 / 4315 / 4316 / 444 / 6461 / 436, journal OD, first note number.
help.section_hr_b3: Payroll is generated from contracts active in the month. Per person you fill leave, sick leave, bonuses, other additions and deductions; worked hours and net are recalculated on the line.
help.section_hr_b4: The timesheet places payroll hours on the firm’s open days, with a time range. If the firm works 6–7 days, a 5-on / 2-off pattern is staggered so the schedule stays covered.
help.section_hr_b5: PDF listings: full payroll, payroll by location, payslips, timesheet, journal note. NextUp Excel (21 columns) is built from payroll — 1:1 pairs, simple note or amounts collected in 4311, preview before saving. No Saga PDF needed.
help.section_hr_tip: If the timesheet shows an error on a person, check payroll hours against the schedule — the app will not invent hours to close the month.
help.section_crm_p1: The CRM tab (navigation bar) centralizes the sales pipeline and customer relationship, Bitrix24-style. It runs in the context of the active ERP company (bottom bar).
help.section_crm_p2: Access requires Clients module permission and access to the selected company. The CRM top-left menu picks the section: Overview, Leads, Deals, List, Contacts, Companies, Quotes, Activities, Analytics, Tickets.
help.section_crm_b1: Overview — pipeline metrics, recent tickets, recent deals.
help.section_crm_b2: Deals (Kanban) — columns by stage (New → Won/Lost); long-press card → Move to stage; + on column for a quick deal.
help.section_crm_b3: Leads — prospects; Convert to deal from lead details.
help.section_crm_b4: Companies and Contacts — auto-sync from ERP Clients; “From ERP” badge = read-only (edit in Clients); “Manual CRM” badge = added in CRM for the active company (+, edit, swipe delete).
help.section_crm_b5: Quotes — lines with quantity/price, automatic total; draft/sent/accepted/rejected status.
help.section_crm_b6: Activities — calls, meetings, tasks linked to deals; mark complete from the list.
help.section_crm_b7: Analytics — sales funnel, win rate, weighted pipeline, open contacts/companies/quotes.
help.section_crm_b8: Tickets — client support (open, in progress, resolved, closed); open ticket from ERP client record.
help.section_crm_tip: CRM assignees are ERP users of the active company — pick them when creating a deal or lead.
help.section_cash_register_p1: The Cash register module (Dashboard → Cash register) generates daily PDF journals on the official accounting template. Receipts come from three sources: cash from Z reports saved in ERP, client collections with method Cash, and documents created manually in the register.
help.section_cash_register_p2: There is no “Send collections to the cash register” button. After the data is in ERP, choose the period and tap Generate registers. Requires an active company and Cash register module permission. Zetta settings (HQ cash account, registers at work locations) are configured in Settings → Zetta settings.
help.section_cash_register_b1: From / To date range → Generate registers — one PDF page per day with operations (no blank days).
help.section_cash_register_b2: HQ register: HQ Z receipts + transfers from work locations; work location: Z receipt + transfer to HQ.
help.section_cash_register_b3: Manual documents stay in the list (current week / current month / all + search) even if you clear generated registers — Generate puts them back. Types: customer receipt, supplier payment (pick the supplier), bank withdrawal / deposit, other. Supplier invoices do not go in by themselves; cash payments from Suppliers do.
help.section_cash_register_b4: Opening balance: enter cash on hand at the start of the period (the evening before From). If you generated the previous month, the closing balance is taken automatically. Days without operations keep the balance. Negative balance → automatic “Advance returned for settlement” line (rounded to hundreds).
help.section_cash_register_b5: PDF preview per day or export per register; on Mac, Save opens the file dialog (no blank screen) and Send opens the share menu. Official template with a diagonal line through empty rows.
help.section_cash_register_b6: Single active work location → HQ register only; multiple locations → separate tile per location.
help.section_cash_register_b7: Z cash receipts: Clients → Zetta → check the Z reports → Generate Excel & Save. The Z reports go to Clients → Z reports. Then Dashboard → Cash register → From / To → Generate registers. The page shows “Receipts per Z no. …”, cash amount only.
help.section_cash_register_b8: Utilities → Scanned Z reports → Zetta import only builds the NextUp Excel and the PDFs. It does not save Z reports in ERP and does not put them in the cash register. For the register use Clients → Zetta → Generate Excel & Save.
help.section_cash_register_b9: Client collection (account sheet or Client situation): choose method Cash and save. When you generate the register, the line appears automatically on the HQ register. Card, bank transfer, or modern payment from a Z report do not go into cash.
help.section_cash_register_b10: Manual receipt: in Cash register, Add document (customer receipt, other). It stays in the list; Generate registers puts it back on that day’s page.
help.section_cash_register_tip: The register does not read from BINA or from the scanned Z utility. Only saved Z reports, client cash collections, and manual documents.
help.section_legal_p1: Privacy, Terms, GDPR Policy, and About app are buttons at the top right of the Help tab. What's New shows the version history directly in the app (RO + EN).
help.section_legal_b3: GDPR Policy — data subject rights, procedures, controller/processor roles.
help.section_legal_b4: About app — app version, database, Resend.
help.section_legal_b5: Support: ERPMobile@dateconta.ro — attach screenshots and version from bottom bar.
help.section_legal_tip: Database schema version (Supabase) appears in About app.
help.section_utilities_p1: The Utilities tab (navigation bar) groups quick tools outside core ERP modules: Zetta import, scanned Z reports → Zetta import, MT940 archive, payroll NextUp from a journal PDF, and Z report extraction from cash register software.
help.section_utilities_p2: Most utilities require an active company (bottom bar). Cash register connection settings are saved per company in the cloud.
help.section_utilities_b1: Create ZETTA import file — same reading flow as Clients → Zetta: import Z report photos/PDFs, NC preview, Excel export. It does not save Z reports under Clients → Z reports. At the top you set the first accounting note number; in Excel, Nr. inreg. continues from there. On Mac: “Save ZETTA file” opens Save dialog (no share sheet).
help.section_utilities_b2: Create MT940 archive — upload bank statement (MT940, CSV, PDF — including Raiffeisen column layout); generates one MT940 file per day (MT940_FIRMA_YYYY-MM-DD.txt); export ZIP archive.
help.section_utilities_b3: Z report extraction — BINA Smart Business: automatic login, date range, POS location, report list, batch download of Romanian PDFs. If the PDF is in English, VAT group sales (BRUT A/B/D) are read from the line after “VAT 21% / 11% / 0%”.
help.section_utilities_b4: Fallback: manually upload PDFs exported from BINA (upload section on the same screen).
help.section_utilities_b5: Z report export folder (Mac): choose parent folder and optional new subfolder; on mobile — Save PDFs after extraction.
help.section_utilities_b6: After extraction, import PDFs in Utilities → Zetta or Clients → Zetta to generate NextUp Excel.
help.section_utilities_b7: Scanned Z reports → Zetta import: the combined PDF is the original scan (all pages, in order). Excel uses the values that were read. Preview without saving; Reread unread pages.
help.section_utilities_b8: NextUp Excel from scanned Z reports: 1) Utilities → Scanned Z reports → Zetta import. 2) Set the first accounting note number (Nr. inreg.). 3) Upload photos or a PDF (one PDF = one firm, one Excel; one page = one Z). 4) Read and create the Zetta file. 5) Unread pages: Reread. 6) Preview the Excel, then Save the Zetta Excel import file.
help.section_utilities_b9: In NextUp: Accounting → Import accounting notes from Excel — one file per firm. Check the partner and the JV / RC / OD journals.
help.section_utilities_b10: This utility does not send receipts to the cash register. For the register: Clients → Zetta → Generate Excel & Save, then Dashboard → Cash register → Generate registers.
help.section_utilities_b11: Create NextUp payroll import from a journal-note PDF: upload the Saga PDF. Next to Nr. inreg. choose a simple note or amounts collected in 4311 (after 444, 4315, 4316, 436 on credit the same account is added on debit and 4311 on credit, with that amount). Preview before saving. NextUp gets 1:1 pairs, not compound notes.
help.section_utilities_tip: For scanned Z reports (photo/PDF): use Utilities → Scanned Z reports → Zetta import. For BINA: extract Romanian PDFs, then import them in Clients → Zetta if you also need the cash register. For salaries: Utilities → Create NextUp payroll import from journal-note PDF.
help.section_zetta_category_p1: Zetta is integrated in ERP Mobile under Clients → Zetta. It reads Z fiscal receipts and generates Excel for NextUp import.
help.section_zetta_category_p2: Below is the complete Zetta manual (same content as the Help button in the module).
help.section_zetta_category_b1: Access: Dashboard → Clients → Zetta, Utilities → Create ZETTA import file, or Utilities → Scanned Z reports → Zetta import. At the top you set the first accounting note number; in Excel, Nr. inreg. continues from there.
help.section_zetta_category_b2: Requires active company with Tax ID and Clients module permission.
help.section_zetta_category_b3: Help button in Zetta — opens the same guide when working in the module.
help.section_zetta_category_b4: Zetta settings (Settings → Zetta settings): configure accounts and VAT rates per company; the accounting note is generated from these settings, not only from built-in schemas.
help.section_zetta_category_b5: NextUp Excel: Clients → Zetta → Generate Excel & Save (saves Z reports in ERP and exports Excel) or Utilities → Scanned Z reports (Excel only, not saved in ERP). In NextUp: Accounting → Import accounting notes from Excel.
help.section_zetta_category_b6: Z receipts in the cash register: only after Generate Excel & Save. Then Dashboard → Cash register → Generate registers. Only cash goes in (“Receipts per Z no. …”). Card and modern payment stay in Excel (OD journal), not in cash.
help.section_zetta_category_tip: Recommendation: scan thermal receipts into a single PDF — far fewer errors than OCR photos.

crm.no_company_hint: CRM works in the context of the active company from the bottom bar.
crm.no_activities_hint: Add calls, meetings or tasks from deal details.
crm.no_leads_create: Tap + to add your first lead.
crm.no_companies_erp_hint: ERP clients appear automatically. Tap + to add a CRM company manually (active company only).
crm.companies_erp_banner: Companies sync automatically from ERP Clients. You can add manually for the active company only.
crm.company_erp_readonly: Company data is edited in the ERP Clients module.
crm.users_erp_banner: Assignees are ERP users of the current company.
crm.no_contacts_erp_hint: ERP contacts appear automatically. Tap + to add a contact manually (active company only).
crm.contacts_erp_banner: Contacts sync automatically from ERP Clients. You can add manually for the active company only.
crm.contact_erp_readonly: Contact data is edited in the ERP Clients module.
crm.no_tickets_create: Tap + to open the first ticket.
crm.client_no_open_tickets: No open tickets for this client.
utilities.cash_register.error_bina_compa: BINA company “%@” was not found in the login account. Check access or the company name in BINA.
utilities.cash_register.export_folder_me: Select the folder where extracted PDFs will be saved.
utilities.cash_register.export_folder_mo: On mobile, use Save PDFs after extraction.
utilities.cash_register.export_folder_pa: First choose the parent folder (e.g. Downloads/Z reports).
utilities.cash_register.export_folder_ne: Leave empty to use the parent folder. Enter a name to create a new subfolder.
utilities.cash_register.error_invalid_fo: The folder name is not valid.
